about: The language of each original verse the articles quote, for the label the site sets above it (Rauf, 30 October 2026: "For the differentiation between the urdu and punjabi make it more obvious"). One entry per distinct verse paragraph, keyed by its exact text. lang: pa Punjabi, pa-Guru Punjabi in Gurmukhi, Guru Gurmukhi (script only), fa Persian, ur Urdu, sd Sindhi, skr Seraiki; null where the language is not certain, which sets no label. pipeline/verse_languages.py writes src/data/verse-languages.json from this file and checks that every verse paragraph in the articles is here.
